title: Exactness of affine direct-image-algebra tensor pullback
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine scheme morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism, def-pc-scheme]. Put $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,f_*\mathcal O_X)$ [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Let $P$ be a functor between the shared module-sheaf categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose objects are the concrete tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback] and whose morphisms are inverse-image module maps followed by extension of scalars, transported along the given object equalities. Then $P$ preserves finite limits and finite colimits. No quasi-coherence condition is imposed on its input objects.

source.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Tag 0AVW, Lemma 36.5.4, affine stalk calculation in the proof

proof.text: Obtain the concrete additive tensor pullback Q and its adjunction to module direct image. The prescribed object and map equalities construct a natural isomorphism P ≅ Q: the two transported tensor maps agree after composing the equality isomorphisms. Transfer additivity and finite-colimit preservation from the additive left adjoint Q to P.

Every stalk map of the canonical morphism to the affine direct-image algebra is flat. Apply the general stalkwise-flat tensor-pullback kernel theorem to P, using its transferred additivity and its prescribed object and map formulas.

An additive kernel-preserving functor between these abelian categories preserves finite limits by Mathlib CategoryTheory.Functor.preservesFiniteLimits_of_preservesKernels. Combine with the finite-colimit instance from the first step.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0AVW, affine-morphism-equivalence; kernel/left-adjoint decomposition formalized by W2, 2026-10-12; source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0AVW

mathlib_searches.query: The ringed space morphism from an affine scheme morphism to its direct image algebra is flat and tensor pullback is exact
Tensor pullback of sheaves of modules along a flat morphism of ringed spaces preserves finite limits and finite colimits
mathlib_searches.results: ModuleCat.preservesFiniteLimits_tensorLeft_of_ringHomFlat, Module.Flat.iff_preservesFiniteLimits_tensorLeft and generic sheaf pullback declarations; no direct-image-algebra flatness theorem.
Mathlib has algebraic tensor exactness, not the affine ringed-space stalk computation. Sheaf.FlatModulePullbackExact is for flat scheme morphisms, which does not apply to g:(X,O_X)->(Y,f_*O_X).

from.place: Derived Categories of Schemes, Tag 0AVW, Lemma 36.5.4, affine stalk calculation in the proof; affine stalk flatness and exactness calculation

theorem affine_algebra_tensorModulePullback_exact
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    (P : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (h : ∀ M, P.obj M = SheafOfModules.changeOfRings.{u, u, u}
      (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap
        (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f).hom.base X.toRingedSpace.sheaf
        (directImageAlgebraSpace f).sheaf ⟨(toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f).hom.c⟩)
      (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f).hom.base
        (directImageAlgebraSpace f).sheaf M))
    (hm : ∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N),
      P.map a = eqToHom (h M) ≫ SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsHom.{u, u, u}
        (CochainComplex.tensorPullbackRingMap
          (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f).hom.base X.toRingedSpace.sheaf
          (directImageAlgebraSpace f).sheaf ⟨(toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f).hom.c⟩)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModule (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f).hom.base
          (directImageAlgebraSpace f).sheaf M)
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageModuleMap (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f).hom.base
          (directImageAlgebraSpace f).sheaf M a) ≫ eqToHom (h N).symm) :
    PreservesFiniteLimits P ∧ PreservesFiniteColimits P
